summary: Added monai/utils/jupyter_utils.py with is_jupyter() and plot_image_grid(), plus tests/test_jupyter_utils.py. Nothing committed. Test run in the prepared venv: 1 passed, 3 skipped, because matplotlib is not installed there, so the plotting path is unverified. Design choices, since the spec gave no API: matplotlib/IPython are imported lazily to avoid the circular import, and the module is not exported from monai/utils/__init__.py.
